videos.headline: Bear Bachmeier keeps it himself to put BYU on the board
Notre Dame's Boubacar Traore ejected for targeting on 1st drive of game
Micah Gilbert makes an awesome one-handed grab for a Notre Dame 1st down
Nolan James Jr. finds pay dirt to give Notre Dame a lead
BYU's trickery pays off for a wild Cougars TD
Bear Bachmeier dives across the goal line for this 2nd rushing TD
Notre Dame QB CJ Carr fumbles while trying to spike ball and BYU recovers
Notre Dame stuffs BYU on fourth down after failed fake punt
Jonaz Walton plows into the end zone to reclaim a lead for Notre Dame
Jayden Sanders snags a big-time INT for Notre Dame
Jonaz Walton finds the end zone for 3-yard TD
